title: Software Engineer
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in Forensic Intelligence, you'll work within a team building capabilities that enable public safety agencies to investigate and analyse the video evidence that officers rely on every day, stored in Evidence.com. You'll contribute to a technically diverse and challenging domain - spanning media processing pipelines, forensic analysis tools, and video format R&D - with mentorship from experienced senior engineers. This is a role where you'll grow quickly, working across the stack on problems that directly support Axon's missions to Protect Life and Preserve Truth.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You'll Do

  • Develop features across the team's scope - from forensic playback and investigation tooling to media processing pipelines and format analysis capabilities
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers to understand customer needs and ensure clear understanding of requirements
  • Contribute to the quality and reliability of the team's systems through code reviews, test automation, and thoughtful engineering practices
  • Work across the stack, learning new technologies and building expertise in the team's domain
  • Participate in operational ownership of the team's services, including on-call support
  • Join forces with engineers across London, Seattle, and Ho Chi Minh City to deliver capabilities used by hundreds of thousands of public safety professionals globally

What You Bring

  • Preferably a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Experience with at least one of: TypeScript/React, Python, or C/C++
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate with your team to solve challenging problems
  • Genuine curiosity and a passion for learning - you're excited by unfamiliar domains and new technologies
  • Good communicator, able to explain your thinking clearly and ask good questions
  • Desirable: Interest in or exposure to video, media processing, or digital forensics
  • Desirable: Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

Benefits That Benefit You

  • Competitive base salary and RSUs
  • Pension plan with matching contributions
  • Private health insurance and cash plans
  • 30 days paid holiday plus UK public holidays
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • GymPass subscription
  • Life assurance and income protection
  • Career growth, learning support, and wellness resources

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Chief of Staff, Strategic Growth & Partnerships (UK)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are seeking a strategic, highly commercial and growth-driven Chief of Staff to spearhead commercial expansion and high-priority strategic initiatives in the UK market. Sitting directly alongside the UK CEO, this role bridges establishing high-value institutional partnerships with executive-level project execution.

This is a high-leverage commercial and sales-focused Chief of Staff role - not an internal, project management or administration-focused role. Moving beyond traditional sales or purely operational roles, this position is designed for a strategic partner. You will act as the UK CEO’s right hand contributing to the long-term strategy, originating institutional partnerships and owning cross-functional strategic projects with the CEO end-to-end. A core element of this role is driving commercial growth alongside the UK CEO. This includes fully grasping the broader landscape, market and competitor dynamics, customer behaviour and regulatory context into actionable strategies for Group-level product and executive leadership.


Your Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development & Commercial Growth

  • Market & Commercial Strategy: Act as the local market strategist, translating UK client context, competitive dynamics, and customer feedback into growth opportunities and clear requirements for leadership.
  • Execute on this Strategy and Drive Partner Origination & Platform Growth: Lead business development initiatives to identify and execute commercial partnerships with banks, asset managers, wealth managers and myriad financial institutions across the UK.
  • Executive Sales Support: Partner directly with the UK CEO on complex commercial partnership negotiations.
  • Deal Structuring & Financial Modeling: Evaluate commercial frameworks, conduct quantitative modeling, and negotiate terms for strategic accounts and commercial initiatives.

Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Strategic Project Management: Own and drive end-to-end execution of CEO-led strategic initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment across local teams and the wider Raisin Group.
  • Executive & Board Preparation: Draft strategic presentations, business cases, and commercial proposals for the UK CEO, Boards (local and Group), and Group executive management.
  • Product Roadmap Alignment: Collaborate with Group product and operational teams to champion UK commercial priorities and integrate required features into the product roadmap.
  • Structured Execution: Maintain rigorous documentation, project cadences, and operational alignment across all UK strategic priorities while navigating Risk, Compliance, and Legal clearance for new commercial structures.

Your Profile

Qualifications & Experience

  • A background in Investment Banking (especially FIG), M&A Advisory, Corporate Finance, Consulting or Strategic BD experience in financial services/fintech is highly desirable.
  • Highly analytical and proactive mindset, avoiding reactive "firefighting" in favor of methodical, structured, data-backed execution and strategic planning.

Essential Skills & Core Competencies

  • Strategic acumen: strong commercial instincts and a thorough appreciation for UK market dynamics.
  • Commercial & Financial Rigour: Strong financial modeling, valuation, contract negotiation, and analytical skills honed in high-pressure environments.
  • Stakeholder Management & Influence: Proven ability to influence, challenge, and align internal Group stakeholders, C-suite executives, and external partners.
  • Versatility: Comfortable pivoting seamlessly between financial modeling, client-facing sales meetings, and internal project coordination.
  • Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills suited for Board level interaction and external partner pitching.

 

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

  • Employee Development Budget of £1,700 and 4 full training days per year.
  • Always hungry? Breakfast, snacks, daily fresh fruit and drinks are at your disposal around the clock.
  • We are hybrid working, we are in the office twice a week, giving the team the opportunity to collaborate and spend time together. Wednesday is our core day in the office.
  • We offer 28 days + Bank Holidays of holiday a year.
  • One day birthday leave to celebrate your birthday.
  • We offer you a company stakeholder pension with a minimum employer contribution of 5%.
  • The opportunity to experience our annual retreats in exciting European cities and other team building events.

Are you a strategic marketer who thrives at the intersection of high-impact brand media and performance growth? Do you want the agility, ownership, and speed of a tech startup, backed by the scale and resources of a global industry leader?

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

 A little about the role...

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Marketing Manager to lead upper-funnel brand media and help scale our growth across international markets.

You’ll take strategic ownership of international brand investment, shape channel strategies across Out-of-Home (OOH), Connected TV (CTV) and digital video, and play an important role in defining how we grow and reach diners internationally.

This is a role with plenty of scope to think big, test ideas and get hands-on with making them happen.

Why this role is unique;

  • Startup autonomy, enterprise scale: Build systems, test new channels and move quickly, while having the backing of world-class data, resources and an established global brand.
  • True end-to-end ownership: From building investment cases and managing agency relationships to designing lift studies and getting hands-on with execution, you’ll have real ownership of the outcome.
  • Cross-functional influence: You’ll bring together media agencies, regional market leads, performance marketing, creative partners and adtech engineering teams to make sure everyone is moving in the same direction.

  • You bring proven experience in integrated, brand or growth marketing, ideally in-house within a consumer tech brand or high-growth international business.

This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. raw.description:
Type: Full-time
Location: University of Sussex, Brighton - On-site

The Role

Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models.

We're looking for a Neuroscientist to join our Brighton research team as an independent contributor driving experiments from design through analysis. You'll design and run in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural experiments, work with large-scale neural and behavioural datasets, and partner closely with our ML team to translate what we learn about real brains and bodies into better foundation models. This is a role for someone who wants their science to feed directly into what gets built next.

Responsibilities

In Vivo Electrophysiology & Neural Recording

  • Design and run in vivo electrophysiology experiments in animal models

  • Develop and refine neural recording protocols and rigs alongside the hardware team

  • Ensure recordings meet the quality and fidelity standards our models are trained on

Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design

  • Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets

  • Plan and oversee data collection sessions, in collaboration with technicians

  • Iterate on experimental design based on data quality and downstream modelling needs

Data Analysis & Computational Modelling

  • Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets

  • Build and apply computational models to characterise neural and behavioural dynamics

  • Validate findings and communicate results clearly to the broader research team

Neuroscience → AI Translation

  • Partner with the ML team to translate biological findings into model design choices

  • Help define what neurobehavioural data and features are most valuable to capture

  • Contribute to internal research direction connecting neuroscience and foundation model development

Requirements

Core (essential)

  • BSc/MSc in neuroscience, behavioural sciences, or a related field, with hands-on experimental research experience.

  • Preferred: PhD and experience with in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural neuroscience experiments

  • Strong data analysis skills, including experience with Python or a similar language

  • Able to design rigorous experiments and think critically about data quality

  • Excellent communication; comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and ML teams

Valued (or willing to learn)

  • Experience with large-scale or multi-modal neurobehavioural datasets

  • Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals or foundation model training

  • Experience with computational modelling of neural or behavioural data

  • Prior work bridging neuroscience and AI/robotics research

Joining our dynamic and ambitious Street.co.uk team, you will be a dedicated product specialist for our customers as they begin their journey with Street, driving client success while identifying opportunities for growth and long-term value across Street Group's ecosystem of products.

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills (fluency in written and spoken English)

  • You're a dependable, motivated, self-starter, with the ability to work independently and the inner drive to grow a company that is in an exciting period of rapid growth

  • Immersing yourself in the company and building knowledge of our evolving product

title: Customer Support Representative
description: Want to do meaningful work that helps real clinics deliver better care? Jane is a practice management platform used by thousands of health and wellness clinics. Our product is robust, multi-faceted and growing, powering everything from scheduling and charting to payments, telehealth, insurance, and more. Our Support team isn’t like most. They don’t just answer questions, they play a critical role in deeply understanding clinic needs, solving real problems, and helping practitioners get the most out of Jane. If you thrive in a fast-learning environment, take pride in doing excellent work, and want to be part of something that’s truly making a difference in the world, this could be the place for you. This role blends support, sales, and onboarding. You’ll lead demos, onboarding calls, and real-time support and troubleshooting across phone, chat, and video - often at high volume, always with a focus on quality and effectiveness over scripts or playbooks. At Jane, our performance bar is “delight,” and reaching it takes effort. Working hard here doesn’t mean working long, but it does mean caring deeply, learning constantly, and aiming higher than “just okay.” Our product is big, and customer needs can be nuanced. One moment you might be troubleshooting a complex health insurance setup, the next guiding someone who’s never used software. We support all kinds of learners, so you’ll need to tailor your communication to meet people where they are. We’re growing fast, which means things move quickly - and sometimes messily. If you’re energised by change, open to coaching, and excited to help build something meaningful, we’d love to hear from you. As we grow, so do the opportunities: whether you're interested in becoming a subject matter expert, shaping systems and strategy, or growing into people leadership, we support a variety of career paths based on your strengths and goals. Our support team members need to thrive for about 12 months before exploring other roles outside of this one! Working Remotely, Together The UK team is fully remote, but we get together in person for co-working days every 2-3 months. It's a chance to collaborate face-to-face, build relationships, and work together on shared projects. You Might Love It Here If ...You love thoughtful feedback that challenges you. At Jane, we do things a little differently, which means trying new approaches, hearing fresh perspectives, and stretching beyond your comfort zone. You feel at home in complexity, whether it’s navigating software or live problem-solving across channels. You’re always looking for ways to make things better, not just checking boxes, but pushing from “good” to “great.” You’re excited to dive into a deep product and use it to solve real, meaningful problems. You bring warmth and clarity to every interaction with customers, leaving them feeling seen, supported, and confident. You care about doing work that matters, and your effort aligns with the team, the customer, and the mission. You thrive in fast-paced, live conversations and can switch gears without losing your stride. You’re endlessly curious and you ask great questions, explore how things work, and look for ways to improve them. Bonus Points Experience with or interest in attending conferences and trade shows is a plus. We exhibit at events across the UK, from smaller shows with 100-200 attendees through to flagship industry events with thousands of delegates. This Role Might Be A Struggle If ...You prefer to work independently without regular feedback. We believe growth comes from stretching ourselves, and giving and receiving feedback is a constant here. You’re uncomfortable being on live video calls, building real-time relationships, or solving problems face-to-face with customers. You thrive behind the scenes or in predictable, established workflows. This is a live, front-facing role with high visibility and day-to-day variety. A fast-paced, ever-evolving environment feels more overwhelming than energizing. Priorities shift quickly, and adaptability is key (your schedule may shift in real time based on live channel assignments). You find learning multiple complex tools simultaneously frustrating. Our product is deep, and curiosity about how things work is essential to succeed here. Compensation & Benefits Jane’s committed to paying our team members fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This is reflected by a strong starting annual salary of £38,795 for all Customer Support Representatives at Jane. You’ll be eligible for a salary increase each year on your work anniversary that will reflect the hard work you’ll be doing to meet our customers’ high bar and the growth you’ll be experiencing in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Joining Jane’s Support team will allow you to build a career with a variety of paths. Some folks will build deep knowledge and expertise in their roles to become Senior Product Specialists. Others may shift gears into “Expert” roles in areas such as Jane Payments, Technical Escalations, and Demos. Some may want to broaden their scope to step into people leadership roles like Team Captains and one day, Country Leads. Each of these career paths come with clear compensation expectations of what you can expect on your work anniversary based on the hard work you’ll put in and the growth you’ll experience. Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals to help folks build trust in the compensation process at Jane. To better understand Jane’s compensation fundamentals and how this range is determined, click on the link below for a short video walkthrough of how it all works! We also welcome you to ask as many questions as you’d like about compensation throughout the interview process to ensure you feel confident and build trust through the process. As a UK-based team member, you'll also receive: Private healthcare, fully covered: Medical, dental, and vision cover through Bupa for you and your dependants Income protection: 75% of your salary covered (up to £100,000) if you're unable to work due to long-term illness or injury, on top of Statutory Sick Pay Life insurance: Cover of 4x your annual salary, up to age 65, through Legal & General. Holiday allowance: Starting at 20 days + bank holidays, plus your birthday off if it lands on a workday, and 3 additional paid days over the Christmas period Jane’s Stock Option Plan (JSOP) : Since 2020 we’ve had three opportunities to sell options for a significant profit, and we hope to continue to create opportunities like this as we grow. The number of options you’ll receive depends on two factors: your starting date and starting salary. Based on Jane’s revenue at your starting date, we’ll set your strike price. Based on your starting salary, we’ll determine how many options you are eligible to receive Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @ jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

The Territory Account Executive (TAE) is a key growth role within Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) Germany's Go-To-Market organisation. This position focuses on driving growth across all accounts not currently managed by an Account Executive, including the full install base, dormant accounts, and new inbound opportunities. TAEs are responsible for expanding Pure’s footprint, reigniting customer relationships, and capturing new business through a combination of direct engagement and partner collaboration.

As a Territory Account Executive (TAE), you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing this vision to life - helping customers unlock the power of their data, modernise their infrastructure, and accelerate transformation. You’ll join our Commercial team in Germany, with the autonomy to own a dynamic territory, driving growth across a broad set of customers, from re-engaging dormant relationships to winning new logos.

At Pure, you’ll join a culture built on curiosity, innovation, and integrity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, challenge convention, and empower our people to think big, take bold action, and make a measurable impact. This is your opportunity to grow your career with one of the most innovative technology companies in the world and to do work that truly changes how businesses use data to compete and win.

 

What You'll Do

  • Drive Account Growth & Pipeline: Execute sales activities to generate revenue, manage a high-volume pipeline, and contribute to closing deals on a quarterly basis.
  • Execute Outreach & Prospecting: Perform consistent, high-activity prospecting to penetrate new accounts, reach decision-makers, and learn how to win new business effectively.
  • Support Partner Strategy: Collaborate closely with Channel Partners and Partner Managers to align on customer engagement and utilise partner resources to advance opportunities.
  • Reactivate Customer Relationships: Focus on re-engaging dormant or inactive customers by discovering new business use cases and identifying potential refresh and expansion opportunities.
  • Build Foundational Skills: Develop and deliver proposals and business cases that clearly demonstrate the value of Pure's solutions, supported by internal experts.
  • Maintain Sales Discipline: Diligently manage sales technology (Salesforce), deliver accurate forecasts, and maintain strong time management to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment.

What You Bring

  • Proven Sales Experience: Demonstrated success in direct, full-lifecycle B2B technology sales with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales metrics (KPIs).
  • Sales Drive & Motivation: A high degree of self-motivation, strong time management skills, demonstrates initiative and the drive to learn quickly and succeed across both transactional and early-stage strategic sales motions. 
  • Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated success working with both internal teams and channel partners to ensure seamless customer engagement and shared goal achievement.
  • Digital Proficiency: Proficiency with core sales technologies, including Salesforce and G Suite, and an ability to use data to prioritise daily activities. 
  • Communication & Presence: Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for engaging with business leaders and maintaining professional business relationships.
  • Resilience & Focus: A competitive, positive attitude combined with strong organisational and time management skills necessary to handle a dynamic, high-activity territory.
  • Language Skills: Business Level, written and spoken, German and English language skills required.

Nice to Have

  • Industry Knowledge: Prior knowledge of the storage industry and familiarity with how data solutions drive business outcomes.
  • Channel Sales Expertise: Understanding of channel-led sales motions and experience collaborating effectively within the broader partner ecosystem.
  • Sales Training: Completion of a structured B2B sales methodology training (e.g., Business Value Selling or similar).
  • Digital Tools: Experience using digital prospecting and engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to accelerate the sales cycle.

title: Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, UGV Platforms (m/f/d)
description: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real world operations. As Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, you will own electromagnetic compatibility across our UGV platforms, starting with our Mandrill UGV: from the grounding and shielding concept on the drawing board to the certificate that puts our vehicles on public roads and into military service. Your goal is one robust E/E design baseline that passes civil homologation (UN ECE R10) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461, AECTP 500) without costly redesign loops. This is a senior engineer role with real ownership and room to grow. You build our EMC capability from the ground up, set the strategy, decide early in the design, and lead campaigns through to certification. You will work at the intersection of high power electronics, vehicle E/E, radios and mission payloads, autonomy compute, suppliers, test houses and authorities. As the platform family and team grow, this role can develop into leading our EMC and compliance function. What is your Day to Day Mission: EMC Strategy and Compliance Ownership Define and own the EMC and E3 compliance strategy for our UGV platforms, covering civil vehicle approval (UN ECE R10, E mark for vehicle and ESA) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461G, MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500 / AECTP 250, MIL-STD-1275). Translate customer, NATO and national requirements into an EMC control plan, requirement matrix and test strategy, and keep them current as configurations evolve. Act as the technical interface to accredited test houses, technical services, type approval authorities and defence customers during qualification and acceptance. EMC by Design Develop and integrate the grounding, bonding, shielding and harness concept for the complete vehicle, with special focus on high voltage and high power electronics: traction inverters, DC/DC converters, battery systems and chargers together with outstanding team of engineers Run EMC design reviews for schematics, PCBs, harnesses, enclosures and connectors; specify filters, transient protection and shielding concepts. Manage RF coexistence on a dense platform: datalinks, GNSS, tactical radios and payload emitters working side by side without degrading each other. Flow down EMC requirements to suppliers, run component level reviews and assess their test evidence. Test, Troubleshooting and Qualification Build our in house pre compliance lab (LISN, spectrum analyser, near field probes, current clamps, automated measurement scripts) so issues are found on the bench, not in the chamber. Plan, witness and lead full compliance campaigns at component, subsystem and vehicle level; drive root cause analysis and verified fixes when tests fail. Use simulation (e.g. FEKO, CST, LTspice) where it saves test iterations. Cross Functional Collaboration and Standards Work closely with payload integration, vehicle E/E, mechanical, autonomy and manufacturing teams so EMC is built in, not bolted on. Create EMC control plans, test procedures, reports and qualification evidence, and turn lessons learned into internal EMC design rules for every future platform and payload. What you bring to the team: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics or a comparable technical field. 8+ years of EMC experience in automotive, commercial vehicle, rail, aerospace or defence , including ownership of at least one product through formal qualification or type approval. Deep knowledge of automotive EMC (e.g. UN ECE R10, CISPR 25, ISO 11452, ISO 7637, ISO 10605) and working knowledge of military EMC (MIL-STD-461; ideally MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500, DEF STAN 59-411 or VG 95370/95373). Strong automotive profiles willing to extend into the military world are very welcome. Solid experience with EMC of high voltage and power electronics systems. Practical measurement expertise at component and vehicle level, and the ability to set up and automate test systems (e.g. Python, Matlab). Structured root cause analysis, ideally backed by methods such as Six Sigma, and audit ready documentation. Confident communication with engineers, suppliers, test labs, authorities and military customers. Fluent in German and English. High ownership, focus on teamwork, pragmatic, and happy to work directly on vehicles and in the workshop. Your Benefits: Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. raw.description:
Job description

Kranus Health builds digital therapeutics for urology and gynecology. Our therapies are developed with clinicians, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers. As regulated medical software, everything you build reaches patients with a real diagnosis.

We're looking for a software engineer who enjoys turning problems into working features, uses AI coding tools actively, and wants to contribute across the full stack. You'll build the apps and services behind our therapies, from patient-facing screens to the backend. One platform powers all our therapies, so what you ship scales across every product. Our small engineering team works across mobile, backend, and web. You'll own features end to end and work closely with product, medical and regulatory colleagues.

What you'll do

  • Build features across our mobile applications and backend services, from patient-facing screens to APIs and data models.
  • Take scoped features from understanding the problem through implementation, testing, and release, with support from the team.
  • Work with coding agents every day. We use an AI-assisted approach to engineering, and every pull request gets an AI-assisted review alongside a human review. You review, test, and take responsibility for what you ship.
  • Investigate bugs across the app and backend, understand their causes, and implement reliable fixes.

What matters to us

  • Strong engineering fundamentals. You've built and shipped software in at least one area: mobile, frontend, or backend. You can read unfamiliar code, reason about its behaviour, and explain the trade-offs behind your decisions. Graduate or senior, this counts far more than years of experience.
  • Full-stack mindset. You're willing to work across mobile, backend, and web, and comfortable being a beginner again in parts of the stack you don't know yet.
  • AI-native engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily workflow. You give them the right context, break work into reviewable steps, and can explain and maintain every line you ship.
  • Code quality. You care about readable, maintainable code and treat tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought. You think through edge cases, verify the full flow end to end, and leave the codebase better than you found it.
  • Systematic troubleshooting. You reproduce first and fix root causes, not symptoms. You work from evidence like logs, stack traces, debugger output, API responses, and database queries. You also don't panic when something breaks in production.
  • Ownership and collaboration. You clarify requirements before building, flag blockers early, and follow through. In code reviews you both give and take feedback, and you change course when there's a better solution.

Helpful experience

  • Flutter/Dart or another mobile development stack.
  • Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, or similar backend frameworks.
  • SQL and relational databases, especially PostgreSQL.
  • React and TypeScript for our web applications.

  • CI/CD, containers, observability, or supporting software in production.

Good to know:Hybrid work, with regular time in our Munich office. English is our working language, and German is not required.


Curious how we work?Take a look at Kranus Health on GitHub.


OUR SUPPORT AND YOUR BENEFITS

  • Trust - We believe in the talent we hire. You will receive a permanent contract. 
  • Body & Mind- You get an "Urban Sports Club" membership andyour own leased bicycle at your free disposal.
  • Future -We support your company pension scheme and will be happy to explain the benefits to you.
  • Impact- Work with meaning? Together with you we improve the health care of patients, every day.
  • Teamwork- You are part of a highly motivated team with flat hierarchies and a lot of fun at work.

Sounds like your next chapter? We'd love to receive your application! If you have any questions about the role or Kranus, feel free to reach out directly to our Senior People & Recruiting Manager, Annkathrin -----

description: Introduction The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking. The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions. About this job The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations , sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks. You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals. No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered. We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026 . Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné). Your profile We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy. Suitable candidates should have: Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship. Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code. Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context. Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction. A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility. An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking , particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy. Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset. Your responsibilities Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will: Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python. Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources. Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction. Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences. Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients. Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes. Our offer We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications. title: Senior Sales Development Representative
description:
About Us

Endor Labs is building the Application Security platform for the software development revolution. Modern software is complex and dependency-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate—enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster. 

Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it's 40-year old C++ code or cutting edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures.

Sound interesting? Let’s talk if you want to be part of the next big leap in security innovation!

About the Sales Development Team

As a Senior Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Endor Labs, you will play a pivotal role in driving our future growth by collaborating with the Marketing and Sales  teams to qualify leads and build a robust pipeline of opportunities. You thrive on engaging with prospects, identifying high-value opportunities, and managing early sales funnel activities. You are motivated by the challenge of learning about new products and are excited to contribute to the development of our demand generation and sales process, the articulation of Endor Labs' value proposition, and the creation of key sales tools and assets. If you're proactive, intelligent, persistent, and a great team player, we want to hear from you!

You’ll join a talented but humble team that will help you accelerate your career. This opportunity will equip you with the skills needed to excel in this role and the next. During your time on this team, you’ll grow and develop your career with strong support from team members who are committed to investing in your success.

We adopt a data-driven, analytical approach to sales development and seek someone confident in both prospecting to customers and helping refine our strategy. If you're proactive, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, this is the role for you.

How You’ll Drive Growth

  • Forge New Opportunities: Team up with Account Executives to uncover and research high-value prospects, setting the stage for impactful connections.
  • Transform Leads into Wins: Take charge of following up on Marketing-generated leads, qualifying them as prime sales opportunities, and seamlessly transitioning them to the right salesperson with expertly arranged meetings.
  • Execute with Precision: Bring our outbound sales playbook to life, driving strategic outreach and generating new business with enthusiasm.
  • Engage & Excite: Reach out to potential customers through dynamic cold-calling and handle inquiries sparked by Marketing efforts, making a memorable first impression.
  • Build Meaningful Connections: Cultivate strong relationships with prospects by asking insightful questions, uncovering their needs, and qualifying their interest for a smooth transition to the sales team.
  • Reignite Interest: Reconnect with potential customers who showed interest but didn’t convert right away, nurturing these leads until they are ready to engage.
  • Drive Performance: Work through lead lists with determination, consistently meeting or exceeding SLAs, and maintaining focused activity to support weekly reporting and performance metrics.
  • Collaborate & Innovate: Partner with Marketing to share valuable feedback and insights, helping refine targeting strategies and messaging to enhance overall campaign effectiveness.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Top Performer: Bring a stellar track record of exceptional performance and past successes in similar roles, showcasing your ability to excel.
  • Communication Dynamo: Utilize your outstanding verbal and written communication skills to connect with impact and drive results.
  • Dynamic Self-Starter: Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with your proactive approach and ability to tackle challenges head-on.
  • Driven Achiever: Channel your strong motivation and determination to consistently push boundaries and achieve top performance.
  • Collaborative Innovator: Excel in a remote-first setting by working seamlessly with diverse teams across functions, driving collaboration and innovation.

Preferred Skills

  • Professional experience in sales or business development, preferably within the cybersecurity or SaaS industry.
  • Experience with sales tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, or similar platforms.

Why Endor Labs

We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. Our dev-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right.

At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer’s success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win.

 

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, CE (UK Evergreen)
description:
About Sayari: 

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

This is not a traditional sales engineering role. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are at the critical intersection of our code, our clients, and their most critical missions. You will be deployed to our most strategic partners, embedding within their environments to solve high-stakes problems that have no textbook answers.

You own the "last mile" of our product's impact , ensuring our technology fundamentally transforms how our users confront challenges such as financial crime, supply chain disruption, and threats to national security.

You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. One day you might be architecting a data pipeline within a client's cloud environment ; the next, you'll be writing production Python to integrate our API into a proprietary analytics platform ; and by the end of the week, you could be briefing a C-level executive, intelligence analyst, or mission director on the outcomes your work has enabled.

You thrive on ambiguity, operate with extreme ownership, and are relentless in your pursuit of delivering real-world value. You will act as a vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams, turning your bespoke solutions into scalable, platform-wide features of Sayari’s product suite.

At Sayari, we’re always looking for great talent to join our team. This is a proactive hiring post for future Forward Deployed Engineer roles, allowing us to connect with amazing candidates like you before a specific seat opens up.

 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Embed and Build: Deploy directly into our clients' technical ecosystems and work with key stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, technical environments, and mission challenges. Design, build, and ship production-grade code. You will write robust Python applications, advanced SQL, and leverage our APIs to solve bespoke challenges at the edge.
  • Own the Outcome: Lead the entire technical lifecycle of our most strategic deployments, from initial discovery and architectural design to implementation and operationalization. You are responsible for ensuring our platform delivers tangible, mission-critical value.
  • Be the Tip of the Spear: Serve as the primary technical authority for our clients. You'll lead deep-dive technical workshops, debug complex systems, and act as a trusted, hands-on advisor on how to best leverage Sayari's platform to achieve their objectives in real-world investigations and missions.
  • Engineer Solutions for the Mission: Deconstruct ambiguous, high-level mission requirements into concrete technical solutions. Architect and implement scalable data models and workflows, ranging from building robust data pipelines into client persistence layers (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) to developing custom Python scripts and prototyping AI/ML models.
  • Shape Our Product: Act as the vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams. You will translate complex, real-world operational needs and feedback into the next generation of Sayari's platform.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing, technical role (Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, etc.).
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, production-ready code, with strong proficiency in programming languages (preferably Python) and its data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas, etc.).
  • Deep fluency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.
  • Hands-on, practical experience consuming, integrating, and reasoning about RESTful APIs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between code and mission. You can articulate highly technical concepts with clarity and conviction to engineers, analysts, and senior leaders alike.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex scenarios.
  • A relentless drive and intellectual curiosity. You are comfortable parachuting into new environments and learning new technologies on the fly.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field strongly preferred

Desired:

  • Practical experience leveraging AI, including prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) or using their APIs to build analytical solutions.
  • Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) and workflow orchestrators (e.g., Airflow, Prefect).
  • Knowledge of graph data technologies (Neo4j, TigerGraph) and their corresponding query languages.
  • Exposure to machine learning applications, particularly in NLP or entity resolution.
  • Experience in, or a demonstrated passion for, high-stakes domains such as AML/Financial Crime, Supply Chain Risk, or National Security.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%

 

The target base salary for this position is £100,000 to £110,000 plus commission and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

 

Benefits: 

  • 100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents
  • Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions
  • A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage),, and parental leave
  • A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities
 
Sayari is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and a fair recruitment process. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable UK law.

Fire Alarm Service & Maintenance Engineer

Field Based - Brighton & Hove & Local Catchment | Circa £35,000 + Benefits and Additional Earning Potential

Company Overview:

Firetecnics is one of London's most trusted, LPCB-certified fire safety companies, with one of the best reputations in the industry built up over more than 35 years. We are the go-to fire safety partner for residential and commercial property professionals, delivering fast, reliable solutions that ensure full compliance and complete peace of mind.

As part of the Helix International Group, Firetecnics combines specialist fire-safety expertise with the capability and backing of a wider risk, compliance and technology group.

We provide fire detection, installation, service, maintenance and wider compliance solutions, combining technical expertise with responsive, personalised customer service.

Role Overview:

Firetecnics is strengthening its regional Service & Maintenance capability and is looking for Fire Alarm Service & Maintenance Engineers based in and around Brighton & Hove. The role is designed around stronger local coverage, with engineers working predominantly within defined regional customer clusters rather than routinely travelling across the whole South East.

Your core focus will be planned fire alarm servicing and maintenance, reactive fault-finding, diagnostics and remedial works. We are looking for engineers with credible hands-on fire alarm experience, a methodical approach to faults and the ambition to continue developing technically.

We also want to broaden our engineering capability across AOV systems and emergency lighting. Previous experience is advantageous but not essential where you have the right fire alarm foundations and willingness to learn; training and support will be provided where required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Service and maintain fire detection and alarm systems in accordance with BS 5839-1:2025, relevant standards and Firetecnics procedures, including planned testing and inspections.
  • Attend reactive fault calls, diagnose system issues methodically and complete first-time fixes wherever reasonably possible.
  • Use panel information, event histories, downloads, laptops and relevant software tools to support fault diagnosis and system interrogation.
  • Identify defects and remedial requirements, completing appropriate small works, upgrades or repairs where required and within competence.
  • Produce accurate engineer reports and compliance documentation, clearly communicating findings and recommended actions.
  • Represent Firetecnics professionally with customers, residents, site teams and internal colleagues.
  • Develop capability across AOV systems and emergency lighting, completing additional training and competency sign-off where required.
  • Maintain appropriate van stock, tools and equipment, work safely and participate in the out-of-hours call-out rota when required.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Hands-on fire alarm service and maintenance experience, with a sound understanding of planned servicing and fault diagnosis.
  • Experience working with conventional and analogue addressable fire alarm systems.
  • A logical, methodical approach to fault-finding and a willingness to develop greater technical independence.
  • Ability to work responsibly on customer sites and take ownership of service activity within your level of competence.
  • Comfort using laptops, diagnostic tools and manufacturer software, or the technical aptitude to develop this capability.
  • Good understanding of BS 5839-1 and BS5839-6:2019+A1:2020, strong reporting and customer communication skills, and sound Health & Safety judgement.
  • Full UK driving licence.

Desirable Experience:

  • FIA training or an equivalent fire alarm qualification.
  • Experience across manufacturers such as Advanced, Kentec, C-TEC, Ziton, Gent, Protec, Notifier, Morley or similar.
  • Exposure to open and managed or closed-protocol systems, remedials, small works or commissioning.
  • Experience with AOV systems and/or emergency lighting; where this is not already part of your skill set, training can be provided.

Why Join Us

This regional recruitment campaign is designed to build engineering capability closer to the customers and communities we support. The intention is for you to work predominantly within Brighton & Hove, reducing unnecessary long-distance travel and building greater familiarity with the sites and systems in your area. Occasional wider regional travel may still be required.

The starting salary is circa £35,000, depending on experience and capability. We are also interested in stronger, more experienced engineers where their technical capability fits the requirement, with the overall proposition considered accordingly.

The package includes a company vehicle and fuel card, overtime and out-of-hours call-out payments, technical and manufacturer training and development across fire alarms, AOV and emergency lighting.

Wider benefits include private healthcare, a 4% matched pension, 4x salary life cover, 23 days holiday with the option to purchase more and Perkpal rewards and discounts.

For the right individual, this is an opportunity to build greater technical breadth and independence within an established fire-safety business, while working closer to home and contributing to a growing regional Service & Maintenance operation.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Principle Accountabilities Assess and underwrite direct credit loan applications within personal discretion, in line with the all regulatory requirements, the Bank’s credit appetite policy and underwriting policies utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools. Produce clear, accurate and concise written documentation, making clear recommendations to the Credit team for loan application requests falling outside of personal discretion or outside of credit policy, escalating cases where necessary to the appropriate Delegated Lending Authorities. Liaise with the Credit team as required in managing the credit risk environment, concentration risk and developing credit policy. Undertake regular checks and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times; escalating immediately any areas of concern Manage a portfolio of advances to a defined arrears and collections policy. Liaise effectively with applicants (or their brokers) and valuers in requests for additional relevant information to support the credit decisioning process. Deliver an excellent service is given to customers, their brokers and Relationship Managers, building and maintaining strong relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards. Ensure compliance with all mandatory policies and adherence to credit procedures to maintain internal credit controls. Fully understand and comply with operational procedures, requirements and SLA’s. Help develop appropriate MI and KPI indicators and reporting, maintaining suitable MI to enable a detailed understanding of Mortgage processing pipeline Actively search for areas of improvement for the Bank and your team and take ownership for delivery of these, setting a good example by displaying appropriate values and behaviour Personal Attributes & Experience Exposure/knowledge of underwriting, with experience in the SME sector, with an understanding of the competitor landscape and the dynamics and trends of the SME market. Excellent credit/financial analysis skills including the analysis of financial accounts, budgets and cashflow forecasting, Understanding of the loan underwriting process and the risks involved and be able to assess applications within a personal discretion and make recommendations and take commercial decisions. Experience of escalating and presenting at Credit Committee level and Arrears Management. Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills. title: Applied AI - Member of Technical Staff
description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role The Applied AI team own Callosum's customer engagements end to end. You will work directly with customer engineering teams to understand their AI workloads, design and run rigorous evaluations against their production pipelines, integrate optimised workflows into their systems, and make sure the results hold in production. At Callosum, Applied AI Engineers are the technical bridge between what customers run and what we build. What you learn shapes the research and platform roadmap. The evaluations you run are how we prove the technology in production. As an early member of the team, you will help build the methodology, tooling, and engagement practices the function runs on. The role is engineering-led: you will employ technical judgment to recognise what kind of system a problem needs and prototype it. You will work closely with the engineers designing new intelligent systems, with the platform team that serves them, and directly with senior technical stakeholders on the customer side. We run a flat Member of Technical Staff structure. Responsibility and scope grow with what you demonstrate, including leadership of the Applied AI function as the team scales. What You'll Build Customer engagement from first workload scoping through evaluation, integration, and production deployment Design and run rigorous evaluations on customers' production workloads: set success criteria, instrument the comparison, present results to their engineering teams Develop deep technical understanding of customer systems (retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, code intelligence stacks) and design optimised Callosum workflows Integrate Callosum workflows into customer environments and support them through to stable production Work with our research and platform teams to turn what you learn into general product capability Build the team's shared methodology: evaluation harnesses, integration runbooks, and engagement standards What You Bring Exceptional technical depth, demonstrated through any of: production systems at scale, research that shipped, or an early/founding role where you owned the system end to end Experience with LLM serving infrastructure, agent orchestration, or retrieval systems Rigour in evaluation or benchmarking work A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership What Sets You Apart Experience working directly with external engineering teams, whether as a forward deployed engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant, or comparable customer-facing role Familiarity with novel accelerator platforms Experience at an early-stage company or in a founding-engineer role What We Offer Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience Equity & Ownership Private healthcare We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all. raw.title: Head of Engineering
raw.description:
About Odin

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

The Role

This is the role for an engineer with high agency, a disdain for bureaucracy, and an instinct to drive things forward without waiting for structure to be put in place. If you've been senior at a slow-moving company and you're frustrated by the gap between what should be possible and what actually ships, this is the antidote.

Odin is post-PMF, revenue-generating, and preparing to scale into the US. We're hiring our founding Head of Engineering.At our stage there's no such thing as a leader who isn't hands-on. The strongest technical contributor in the room should be you. We don't have capacity for non-technical middle management.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering execution. Accountable for what engineering ships and how. About half the role is hands-on in the codebase - owning features and the harder calls in the system.

  • Engineering standards. Code quality, testing, code review, documentation, post-mortems, on-call - the bar gets set here, and held.

  • Performance management. Give direct, specific, technical feedback quickly when someone isn't performing, and make the hard calls. Grow people through high standards and direct feedback - not frameworks, PIPs, or formal coaching programmes.

  • Hiring and team growth. Hiring, onboarding, and developing engineers as the team grows from six to ~15-20 over the next two years.

  • AI productivity. Turning individual AI productivity gains into team-level output that customers feel - through how the team works, what gets built, and what gets measured.

  • Engineering reliability. Root-cause discipline, pre-mortems before customer-facing launches, on-call, incident response - the practices that make shipping bug-free a system, not a hope. Especially important given the financial accuracy required across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Working with Product. Product owns what we ship; engineering owns how it's built so we can ship regularly and reliably. The answers to "why is it built this way?" live here.

  • Technical partner relationships. Engineering counterpart on banking, KYC, custodians, and vendor diligence. Build-vs-buy calls sit here too.

The kind of person who thrives here

The right person is intense in the best way: action-oriented, curious, direct, and frustrated by slow delivery. A through-and-through builder - you still write code in your spare time, you're naturally pulled to the hardest problems, and you can't stop until you've shipped the solution.

Senior engineers respect you because you've earned it through your work, not because of your title. They want to be managed by you because you're the strongest engineer in the room and the one who gives direct, useful feedback. You can call something out and have it taken on board - the team already knows you're brilliant at the actual work. Feedback runs both ways: just as direct when it's coming at you.

Weighing engineering decisions by customer impact, not engineering aesthetics. The question is "how does this actually affect the customers of the business?" - not "is this technically nice."

Pragmatic risk judgement: engineering effort proportional to consequence. Comfortable saying "this is fine" when risk is genuinely low; equally comfortable holding the line where money or compliance is involved.

Tailoring communication to the audience - engineers, product, leadership, founders. Same person, different register. You ask questions until things genuinely make sense; "disagree and commit" while still confused isn't your move.

If you've built engineering before - as a founder, a CTO, a Head of Engineering, or an engineering leader without the formal title - this is the chance to do it at the right stage. Post-PMF, revenue-generating, six engineers, plenty still to figure out, and the engineering org genuinely yours to shape. If you hear someone has 50x'd their output with AI and your instinct is to dig in rather than scoff, even better.

Bottom line

This role shapes how engineering grows at Odin - what gets shipped, how it gets shipped, who joins, who stays, and what we expect of each other. The team will rise to meet the bar you set. Your job is to make sure the bar is high enough to matter, and to hold it.

The Hiring Process

Our process is entirely real-time - no take-home assignments, no async tasks. We want to see how you actually think and work, including how you use AI in your day-to-day. The final stages happen in-person.

  1. You start with a call with Imani, our Head of People, to unpack the role and learn more about us.

  2. Then a few different conversations with Mary, Paddy, and our external technical advisor - covering culture and values, working through real technical problems together, and digging into how you think about hiring, performance management, and technical depth.

The process typically runs over two weeks. We share detailed feedback within 24 hours of each stage and aim to line up next steps quickly so momentum isn't lost.

Salary

The salary band for this role is £140,000 - £170,000 + equity options. During the hiring process, we'll assess your experience and capabilities to determine your starting salary.

Working at Odin

Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in the UK with quarterly trips to London.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

Compensation: £140K – £200K • Offers Equity

  • Collaborative, humble, and driven

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive III to join our Sales team.

title: Stagiaire Campagnes d'Influence
description:
En bref

Chez Picnic, nous ne faisons pas que réinventer les courses en ligne : nous grandissons vite et continuons à nous développer dans de nouvelles zones de livraison chaque mois. Pour accompagner cette croissance, notre équipe marketing travaille chaque jour à faire découvrir les avantages de Picnic à toujours plus de consommateurs.

Ta mission : contribuer au développement de la notoriété de Picnic en France grâce à des campagnes d'influence créatives et performantes. Tu participeras à toutes les étapes des projets : de la définition du brief jusqu'à l'analyse des résultats, avec un réel niveau de responsabilité.

En tant qu'alternant·e Influence Campaign Manager, tu rejoindras notre équipe Customer Marketing pour contribuer au développement des campagnes d'influence de Picnic en France. Tu travailleras au quotidien avec notre agence partenaire ainsi qu'avec nos équipes internationales afin de donner vie à des campagnes créatives à fort impact.

Le poste de stagiaire est à pourvoir à partir de janvier 2027. 

Tes missions

Rattaché·e au Brand & Media Manager France, tu coordonneras le déploiement des campagnes d’influence sur le marché français, en lien direct avec notre agence partenaire.

Tu seras notamment amené·e à :

  • Participer à la définition des briefs créatifs des campagnes avec notre équipe internationale et notre agence
  • Sélectionner et challenger les profils d'influenceur·euse·s proposés par l'agence en évaluant leur pertinence, leur audience et leur adéquation avec la marque Picnic
  • Coordonner le suivi des campagnes, de la production des contenus jusqu'à leur publication
  • Analyser les performances des campagnes, contribuer aux reportings et identifier des pistes d'optimisation
  • Réaliser une veille continue sur les tendances des réseaux sociaux, les créateurs de contenu et les activations de la concurrence

À propos de toi

  • Tu suis une formation dans un domaine lié à la communication, la publicité et/ou le marketing, idéalement avec une première expérience en gestion de projet
  • Tu es autonome, organisé·e et attentif·ve aux détails
  • Tu as envie d’apprendre dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des réseaux sociaux et de l’univers de l’influence
  • Tu maîtrises le français et l’anglais
  • Tu es à l'aise avec Excel et avec les KPI d'une campagne d'influence

Avantages Picnic

🍴 Restauration

Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux restaurants du coin. Notre petite cuisine est également équipée de savoureux en-cas et rafraîchissements.

🚲 Santé et transports

Grâce à nos partenariats avec Sidecare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques.
